import json

# Parse the final_out to extract the three JSON blocks
sections = final_out.split('\n\n')
# Find the JSON blocks
json_blocks = []
current_block = []
in_json = False
for line in final_out.split('\n'):
    stripped = line.strip()
    if stripped.startswith('{'):
        in_json = True
        current_block = [line]
    elif in_json:
        current_block.append(line)
        if stripped == '}':
            json_blocks.append('\n'.join(current_block))
            in_json = False
            current_block = []

print(f"Found {len(json_blocks)} JSON blocks")

# Parse user record
user_record = json.loads(json_blocks[0])
address = json.loads(user_record['address_json'])
payment_methods = json.loads(user_record['payment_methods_json'])
preferences = json.loads(user_record['preferences_json'])

# Parse order record
order_record = json.loads(json_blocks[1])

# Parse order items
order_items = []
for i in range(2, len(json_blocks)):
    order_items.append(json.loads(json_blocks[i]))

print(f"User: {user_record['name']} ({user_record['email']})")
print(f"Address: {address['address1']}, {address.get('address2','')}, {address['city']}, {address['state']} {address['zip']}")

print(f"Items: {len(order_items)}")
for item in order_items:
    print(f"  - {item['name']} (Qty: {item['quantity']}, ${item['unit_price']:.2f})")
print(f"Total Paid: ${order_record['total_paid']:.2f}")
